ai_positioning.summary: The company PTC does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses primarily on financial aspects, acquisitions, and business operations, without addressing emerging technologies such as AI.

risks.summary: A cyberattack could compromise customer or internal data, harm reputation, and lead to financial losses.
risks.score_rationale: Risk is central in the 10-K, with a dedicated approach (Zero Trust, NIST, OWASP). The language is strong ("mitigate all security threats"). Governance is strengthened, signaling an existential risk. Highly weighted category.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party suppliers
risks.summary: A security breach at a supplier could expose PTC's or its customers' systems or data.
risks.score_rationale: The VRM program is detailed, with strict contractual requirements. Repeated mention of risks related to external access. Cautious language ("manage risk"). Major operational risk but not existential.

risks.title: Concentration of development activities in India
